newsitem.title: USA: Carson Pirie to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Carson Pirie to buy back shares.

text.p: Carson Pirie Scott & Co said Thursday its board had authorized the repurchase of up to $20 million of stock over the next two years.
The purchases will be made in the open market and in negotiated transactions, it said.
Implementation of the buyback will depend on market conditions, the company's other cash requirements,and other factors, Carson said.
As of January 29, Carson had 15,929,040 shares outstanding.
The buyback program supersedes an existing $20 million buyback plan announced in March 1996.
"We are continuing our stock buyback program, begun in 1994, with increased authority from our board of directors," Stanton Bluestone, chairman, said in a statement.
Carson operates 53 department stores and four furniture stores.
